entities.summary: The Revival Lê dynasty, also called the Later Lê Restoration in historiography, officially Đại Việt, was a Vietnamese dynasty that existed between 1533 and 1789. The Primal Lê dynasty (1428–1527) and the Revival Lê dynasty (1533–1789) collectively formed the Later Lê dynasty.
